SW100-C0435.rationale: Replaced the shared /tmp queue with a private user-owned directory and descriptor-relative no-follow reads, persistent cooperative flock, strict regular-file/schema checks, exclusive temporary creation and atomic replacement. Separate O_EXCL lock creation and no-create opening resolve the independently observed Darwin cold-start ENOENT without unlinking a live lock. Queue symlinks, hardlinks, public files, corrupt content and parent links reject; independent concurrent callers preserve all admitted entries.

source_checks.observation: Exclusive lock creation, existing-file opening without O_CREAT, bounded ENOENT handling; lock is never removed.
No-follow parent traversal, private ownership validation and stable flock descriptor.
No-follow private regular-file read with schema rejection preserving the old queue.
Exclusive temporary, file sync, atomic descriptor-relative replacement and directory sync.

SW100-C0298.rationale: The purge root is the logical repository, and importable Python/native source and bytecode suffixes are excluded rather than depending on a hand-maintained filename allowlist. Directories and symlinks are not moved and an existing archive destination rejects. An independent fixture package still imports and exposes its value after categorization; this does not certify database consolidation or other purge policies.

source_checks.observation: Python source, bytecode and native extension suffixes are excluded from archival.
Only regular files are considered and preexisting destination objects reject.

SW100-C0437.rationale: Preflight requires an already-selected main and a clean tracked/untracked tree without checkout/reset. A private exclusive recovery directory receives a synchronized bundle of all refs plus HEAD; Git verifies the bundle and original HEAD before the rewrite boundary. Independent real Git fixtures restore HEAD and contents by cloning the bundle and confirm branch/stash preservation. Dirty states and unsafe backup-directory links reject without history changes. Actual filter-repo, subsequent ledger writes and publication were not executed.

source_checks.observation: Main and clean tracked/untracked state required; byte porcelain avoids filename decoding errors.
Private recovery bundle created, synchronized and verified before rewrite admission.
Git checks bundle integrity and presence of the expected original HEAD.
Backup is reverified at the rewrite boundary.

SW100-C0448.rationale: Delete selection is restricted to an exact case-normalized apex domain (allowing one DNS terminal dot) and genuine SPF TXT prefixes. Neighbor and lookalike domains and unrelated apex TXT records survive independent recorded HTTP fixtures; an HTTP denial aborts the request helper. No real Cloudflare/iCloud changes, complete API behavior, transactional migration or idempotency are certified.

source_checks.observation: Apex name equality gates all deletion, then only MX or leading v=spf1 TXT records qualify.
HTTPError terminates the helper with failure rather than allowing the caller to continue.

SW100-C0490.rationale: Before installation, a symlinked or non-directory .github path is explicitly rejected. Each replaced regular instruction or noncanonical link is moved without overwrite into a fresh private workspace recovery directory before a canonical link is installed. The independent symlink-parent reproduction initially moved an external instruction; after the correction that external file and internal instructions remain intact and installation rejects. Independent valid installation retains exact workspace/Copilot instruction bytes in the backup.

source_checks.observation: Symlinked/non-directory .github is refused before instruction mutations.
Fresh private recovery directory preserves existing instruction objects before replacement.
Workspace and Copilot links are installed after preservation.

independent_tests.probe: Cold-start direct thread probe reports queue_len 6, 6, 50 after fix, with no client exceptions.

resolved_findings.observation: Installer followed a preexisting .github directory symlink and moved an external instruction.
Concurrent initial O_CREAT|O_NOFOLLOW open of .queue.lock returned ENOENT despite a live directory and extant lock, rejecting one of six callers.
resolved_findings.fixed_by: Separate exclusive creation from existing-file opening and use bounded ENOENT retries; no lock deletion.

fixture_adjustments: The first standalone probe used macOS TMPDIR through /var, a symlink correctly rejected by no-follow traversal. The concurrency probe then used the physical pathname of its own newly created temporary fixture, without changing production root semantics.
scope_limits: All execution used synthetic HOME, keys, directories and owned temporary repositories. No operator queues/instructions/data, provider/mail/iCloud/network/hardware or real repository history/publication was accessed or mutated.

Queue guarantees concern cooperating local POSIX clients. Same-UID hostile ancestor renames, noncooperating lock replacement, crash recovery and exactly-once retry semantics after post-replacement sync errors are not certified.

Installer preservation is for the selected workspace instruction replacement paths and preexisting parent-link rejection. Multi-file crash atomicity and arbitrary concurrent hostile same-UID parent swaps are outside the verified scope.
C0298 closes package/importable archival, not database or data-retention safety of other purge policies.
C0437 closes backup/dirty preflight, not correctness of inherited filter-repo callback, ledger pipeline or force-push; those effect boundaries were not executed.
C0448 verifies target record selection and HTTP-error control flow using recorded requests, not real DNS propagation or an atomic/idempotent migration.
